name: Hive Core
pitch: The living centre of the infestation: a cathedral of flesh where the floor grows back under your feet and the walls have a pulse.

theme.floor: Hive creep everywhere #2a0f33 with pulsing veins #b04dff; exposed bone-white floor #d8cbb8 where creep is scorched or absent
theme.walls: Organic blocks with the creep material and a breathing scale; rib-like tall blocks #3d1f47 with bone caps
theme.lighting: Key light deep magenta-violet #7a3f9e, intensity 0.7, 45 deg from the south-east; ambient #2a1433 at 0.4; vein emissive does most of the lighting; acid pools add #7cff3a glow (acid only)
theme.signature_detail: A heartbeat drives the whole zone: every 10 s the room pulses (walls scale 1.0-1.05, veins flash bright, a low thump plus a light haptic) and creep jumps one tick forward. Scorched cells smoke and leave bone-white floor that slowly re-veins
theme.audio: Heartbeat thump every 10 s, wet organic ambience, choir-like hive drone that swells near nests, sizzling when creep burns

signature: Creep is the enemy here. It slows you 35% and heals and speeds the swarm, and on these floors it grows twice as fast as anywhere else. So you carve your own ground: dash lines scorch it, barrels and explosions burn holes in it, Incendiary rounds paint safe lanes. Nests are seeds, hive walls are seeds, and the heart pulse grows everything at once. Kill the seeds first and the floor recedes; ignore them and you fight knee-deep in it.

floors.events: Teach. Creep fields. A guaranteed Incendiary Rounds drop at 5 s with the hint 'SCORCH THE CREEP: DASH, EXPLODE, BURN'. Three nests keep regrowing it: the burn bar visibly stalls until they die. Barrels sit in the thickest fields.

Twist. Ventricles: each nest is sealed in a chamber behind hive walls (one from the hub side, one from the outer side). Shooting a wall open starts its 12 s regrow clock, so you hold the gap or get sealed in with the nest's spawns. Carapace charges break hive walls (and Carapaces are drawn to block gaps).

Test. The Torch is a flamethrower cart that scorches a 2-cell lane as it rolls, but stops on creep (it only moves on scorched or bare floor). Burn the track ahead of it, keep enemies off it. The Gardener (mini-boss) appears at 40% and re-creeps the track ahead.

Climax. Each ring sits on creep: scorch the ring before standing in it, or hold it at -35% speed. The heart pulse every 10 s regrows every hive wall on the floor and adds a creep tick everywhere. Acid pools line the routes between chambers.
The Hive Heart. The Overmind floats in a chamber inside a heart built of rib blocks; four Psionic Nodes are nests in the corners; acid pools ring the heart.

miniboss.name: The Gardener
miniboss.body: A hive tender, HP 65. Walks at 0.7x along the cart track and every cell it touches becomes creep (one seed per second). Every 8 s Bloom: a hive wall grows in a ring of 4 cells around a random enemy (purple ring, 1.0 s), shielding it. It heals nests in 8 m. Counterplay: it takes double damage while standing on scorched floor, so burn a patch ahead of it and wait; fire stops its creep seeding for 3 s.
miniboss.look: Grand Mender: Drone model at 2.4x, tinted bone #d8cbb8 with a violet emissive sac #b04dff on its back, trailing creep decals.

boss.name: The Overmind, enthroned in the Hive Heart (enemies doc 3.5, zone version)
boss.body: HP 400, stationary, floating above a heart built from rib blocks. Phase 1 (Shielded): the shield holds while any of the 4 Psionic Nodes (the corner nests, 30 RH, each tethered by a Mender) lives. Systole every 10 s: the heart contracts and a ring of creep bursts out (2 cells), plus Mind Lash (a rotating red line, 1.0 s preview, 15 damage) every 8 s. Phase 2 (100-50%): Puppet (3 enemies crowned and frenzied until it takes 40 damage) and Psychic Mirror (2 purple clones of the hero). Systole now also regrows hive walls inside the heart's mouth, sealing it: shoot or blast them to keep a firing line. Phase 3 (50-0%): Hive Bloom: 2 nodes regrow, creep spreads from the heart every 5 s and the acid pools spill (each pool grows 1 cell per 10 s). Counterplay: kill nodes in order of the Mender tethers, scorch a lane from the heart's mouth to a node, and save explosions for the walls inside the mouth.
boss.look: Bloater at 2.0x, pink-grey brain tint #c58a9a with violet veins, bobbing 1.5 m above a pedestal; the heart is a ring of rib blocks (tall B blocks, creep material) that scale 1.0-1.08 on each Systole with a violet point light inside; shield = Bulwark bubble at 4 m in violet.

modifiers: Overgrowth: creep ticks twice as fast and the cap rises to 60% of the floor.
Fortified Hive: hive walls take 15 RH and regrow in 8 s.
Acid Seep: every nest is ringed by acid cells.
Hive-linked Swarm: 20% of spawns are Hive-linked (enemies doc modifier).

rewards.first_clear: Adds Purge Charge to the drop pool (epic) and unlocks the 'Heartbreaker' banner. +30 Cores.
rewards.replay: Thermal Projector blueprint zone. The creep fields reward fire builds (Incendiary, Pyromaniac, Dragon's Breath), so it is the zone players take a new fire build to.

stars.3: Destroy every nest on every floor before it spawns a third Drone, and win the boss with the Overmind's shield down in under 30 s.
stars.bonus: Scorch 500 creep cells in one run.

layout_notes.core-a: Creep Fields. Open ground under thick creep, three nests, acid pools, barrels in the densest fields.
layout_notes.core-b: Ventricles. Four corner chambers sealed by hive walls around a central hub; acid in the hub.
layout_notes.core-c: Torch Run. The cart track runs from the south-west up through the middle to the north-east, crossing every creep field.
layout_notes.core-d: Pulse Chambers. Five ring spots: four in creep chambers and one in the heart-like centre around a nest.
layout_notes.core-boss: Hive Heart. The heart of rib blocks in the centre with its mouth to the south, the Overmind inside, four nests in the corners, acid pools around the heart.

name: Broodmother's Spire
pitch: A kilometre-tall tower of chitin grown out of the hive, with the Broodmother at the top: every mechanic you have learned, in the order that hurts most, and then her.

theme.floor: Ridged chitin #2b2230 with creep #2a0f33 and violet veins #b04dff; the spire's open edges fall away to a red-orange dusk sky far below
theme.walls: Chitin spines as tall blocks #3d2c45 with bone tips #d8cbb8; hive walls breathing
theme.lighting: Key light dusk amber #ffb070, intensity 1.0, 15 deg very low from the west (huge long shadows); rim light violet #9a5cff at 0.8 from the east; ambient #3a2540 at 0.35. Each floor is higher, the sky darker
theme.fog: Below the spire: dusk cloud sea #6b3a4a; on deck violet haze #2e1838, linear 25-60 m
theme.signature_detail: The spire visibly sways (the camera has a 0.3 deg slow roll) and the whole hive below is visible through the pits: Act I-III zones as tiny lights on the plain. The Broodmother's roar is heard once per floor from above, with dust falling
theme.audio: Wind at height, the spire creaking like a ship's hull, a slow choir drone rising in pitch per floor, the Broodmother's distant roar

signature: The final exam, curated. Each floor puts two or three of the mechanics you've already mastered against each other: creep that slows you next to pits that kill the swarm, crumbling walkways that close routes while a creep tide chases you, hive walls that hide eggs, vents and spore pods guarding the beacon. Every floor ends higher up the spire, and the boss fight ends the game with the floor itself falling away.

floors.events: Teach (it's a reminder). The Root Gate: creep, hive walls, egg clusters, pits on the west edge and vents in the lower deck. Every wave includes an elite with 2 modifiers. Wave 3 is led by a Warcry Shrieker.

floors.params: 5 black boxes from the first strike team
floors.events: Twist. The first strike team didn't make it: their recorders ($) lie in dark pockets, hive-walled nooks and beside a crumbling ledge. Each pickup plays a 3 s radio line from the dead squad (the story beat of the act) and triggers its ambush. The lift is at the south-west, past a pit bridge that crumbles.

Test. Plant the orbital beacon (G) on the ridge between two chasms and keep it alive for 60 s. Enemies come over crumbling bridges from both sides (shove and void kills), Lancers fire across the chasms. The Choir (mini-boss) arrives at 25 s.

floors.params: 4 spinal-node charges, then 25 s to the lift
floors.events: Climax. Blow the spire's spine so it can't regrow: plant the four charges (!), two of them across pit belts on crumbling walkways. On the last plant the 25 s countdown starts AND a creep tide (FRONT, creep skin, 1.4 m/s) surges from the south behind you: the lift is at the top, across the last crumbling walkway. The explosion shakes the whole spire and leads straight into the boss intro.

The Crown of the Spire: an inner arena (egg sacs, pillars, the jump pad) inside a ring of crumbling chitin, an outer ring with the med stations, and the lift at the south edge for the escape after she falls.

miniboss.name: The Choir
miniboss.body: Three linked elites (Hive-linked rule: they share damage and die together): a Warcry Shrieker (shields its allies), a Grand Mender (heals all three, revives Drones) and a Marksman Lancer (3-spine fan across the chasm). Total pool HP 90. While all three stand within 8 m of each other they are immune to knockback; split them and they are not. Counterplay: area damage hits all three links at once (Grenade, Chain Lightning, Tesla Coil); a wind of explosions on a bridge, or a shove when one walks a crumbling bridge, drops one in a pit, which kills the whole Choir.
miniboss.look: The three enemy placeholders at 1.6x, all with gold elite rims and a single violet tether line linking them in a triangle.

boss.name: Broodmother Ascendant (enemies doc 1.6, final version with a 4th phase)
boss.body: HP 480, size 3.6 m. Phases 1-3 are the enemies doc fight at final-zone strength: Brood (clutches every 5 s, Tail Sweep, egg sacs hatch Ticks), Acid Rain (Acid Barrage, pillars block it) and Swarm Call (she burrows for 8 s while two waves pour in, then erupts under the hero). Zone rule throughout: every slam of hers cracks the nearest crumbling chitin cell, and enemies shoved off the ring fall. Phase 4 (25-0%): The Spire Falls. She tears the crown loose: the whole crumbling ring around the inner arena falls into the void over 4 s (cell by cell, outward from her), so the fight is on the inner island; the jump pad is the only link to the outer ring and the med stations. Creep pours from her abdomen (one tick every 2 s around her, 3-cell cap per tick), clutches every 3 s. Ledge Teeter: when an explosion, a Barrage knockback or her own Tail Sweep miss pushes her within 1 m of the island lip, she teeters for 3 s and takes double damage (once per 12 s). At 10% she makes a final leap to the outer ring through the jump pad (she's too big; the pad breaks) and the last 10% is fought on the outer ring with the void between you. On death: the spire breaks, a 15 s OUTRUN to the lift with the creep FRONT behind you (no damage unless you stop: the victory lap), and the credits roll from the lift.
boss.look: Bloater at 3.0x, deep violet #4b1f5c with a 1.8x stretched abdomen, crown of Lancer spikes x6 in bone white, violet emissive veins; phase 4 adds a cracked orange-amber glow #ffb070 in her seams (the dusk light coming through).

modifiers: Final Tide: every floor has a slow creep FRONT (0.6 m/s) from the south.
Royal Guard: every elite has 3 modifiers.
Crumbling Spire: every walkway cell next to a pit is a crumbling cell.
Endless Brood: nests on every floor respawn 20 s after death.

rewards.first_clear: The game's ending: unlocks the 'Swarm Breaker' title, a gold spire banner and +50 Cores.
rewards.replay: Rail Cannon blueprint zone (zones 18-21 in the upgrade doc). Broodmother Ascendant is the Hive Hunt anchor boss, and Hard/Nightmare clears are the long-term flex.

stars.3: Defeat the Broodmother Ascendant without leaving the inner island in phase 4 (no jump pad).
stars.bonus: Finish the DETONATE floor with the creep tide never touching you.

layout_notes.spire-a: Root Gate. Creep and hive walls at the north gate, pit edges on the west, egg clusters, two Spore Pods, vents on the lower deck.
layout_notes.spire-b: Fallen Squad. Five recorders in pockets (dark nooks, hive-walled rooms), the lift at the south-west past crumbling pit bridges.
layout_notes.spire-c: Beacon Ridge. The beacon on a ridge between two chasms, crumbling bridges north and south, a permanent centre crossing.
layout_notes.spire-d: The Spine. Pit belts with crumbling crossings, four spinal nodes, the lift at the top north-west.
layout_notes.spire-boss: Crown of the Spire. Inner arena (egg sacs, pillars, jump pad) inside a crumbling ring, outer ring with two med stations and the lift at the south edge.

name: Swarm Gate (endless)
pitch: Endless Breach: the swarm's own gate, and every floor of every zone you have cleared stitched into one descent that only ends when you do.

theme.floor: Per floor: the source zone's theme. The gate's own layouts: black glassy stone #121018 with violet circuit-like veins #b04dff and a cyan floor-number ring #4fd2ff at the spawn
theme.walls: Gate rings as tall blocks #24202c with violet emissive seams; the portal cells inside the gate glow pale cyan #9fe6ff
theme.lighting: Gate layouts: key light cold violet-white #d9ccff, intensity 0.9, 55 deg from the north; the portal is a cyan point light #4fd2ff at 3.0; ambient #2a2433 at 0.4. Borrowed layouts keep their zone's lighting, with a violet rim light added from floor 20 on to show depth
theme.fog: Gate: violet #1a1424, linear 20-55 m; it darkens 2% per floor reached (capped at floor 40)
theme.signature_detail: A big floor counter (Roman-style block numerals) burns into the floor at the spawn for 2 s at the start of each floor; your previous best floor is marked by a gold ring on the lift when you pass it
theme.audio: Each floor uses its source zone's ambience under a rising gate drone; the boss floors cut to silence for 1 s before the banner

signature: The replay engine. Each floor pulls a random layout (and its mechanics) from every zone the player has cleared, plus the two gate layouts, with an objective chosen from that layout's markers. Power climbs every floor, every 5th floor is a boss from the boss pool, and between floors you pick one of three Gate Boons (a run-long upgrade) or keep your health. The mechanics list above is only for the gate's own layouts (they borrow creep, gusts, dark pockets and pits); everything else comes from the source zones.

floors.events: Opening floor of each 5-floor cycle. Floor 1 of the run is always the Gate Antechamber; later cycle-openers pull a random cleared zone's floor-1 layout. Enemy budget: zone-1 budget x (1 + 0.12 x (floor - 1)), elite chance +1% per floor, modifier slots +1 every 10 floors.

floors.params: cycle floor 2: random objective the layout supports
floors.events: A random layout from any cleared zone; the objective is picked from what its markers allow (HOLD/UPLINK on Z, RELAY on R, HUNT on n, SALVAGE on $, DEFEND on G, ESCORT on Q, DETONATE on !), never the same objective twice in a row. Shown here on the gate antechamber's three rings.

floors.params: cycle floor 3: 45 s + 3 s per cycle
floors.events: A pressure floor on the gauntlet arena or a random SURVIVE-capable layout. From floor 13 on, a mini-boss from the pool (Gale Ravager, Deck Crusher, Hot Gravid, Tunnel Matron, The Gardener, The Choir, and Act I-II mini-bosses) arrives at the midpoint.

floors.params: cycle floor 4: random objective, plus a Gate Mutator
floors.events: A random layout and objective as on cycle floor 2, plus one mutator from the upgrade doc pool (9.3) for this floor only, shown on a slot-machine banner. Clearing it pays double Alloy.

floors.params: cycle floor 5: boss from the pool (floors 5, 10, 15 ...)
floors.events: A boss from the pool, fought in its own zone's boss layout or in the gauntlet arena. No repeats until the pool is exhausted. Every 25th floor the boss is doubled (two from the pool at 60% HP each).

miniboss.name: Mini-boss rotation
miniboss.body: Floors 13+ (cycle floor 3) add one mini-boss from the pool of every mini-boss in the cleared zones, at the floor's power. Each has the same rules as in its home zone; when the layout lacks its mechanic (no vents for Hot Gravid, no pits for Gale Ravager), it uses the home-zone fallback (Hot Gravid's radiation pools stay, the Ravager stuns on walls as in the enemies doc).
miniboss.look: Home-zone look with a cyan gate rim light.

boss.name: Boss pool
boss.body: Every boss the player has beaten: Gravid Bloater and the Act I-II bosses, Cloudbreaker, Fallen Vanguard, Core Behemoth, The Gloom, The Overmind, Broodmother Ascendant, and the enemies-doc bosses (Broodmother, The Maw). Boss HP scales with floor power; from floor 30 each boss gains its elite rule (one modifier) and from floor 50 two. Mechanics a boss needs that the gauntlet arena lacks are swapped for its home boss layout. Beating a boss floor offers an Epic card choice and a guaranteed power-up chest.
boss.look: Each boss keeps its home look plus a cyan gate rim light and the floor number on its banner.

modifiers: Gate Mutators: cycle floor 4 rolls one mutator from upgrade-system.md 9.3 (Volatile, Frenzy, Brood Surge, Blackout, Lightning Storm and the rest).
Weekly Seed: one fixed layout/objective/boss sequence per week for the leaderboard ladder.
Hardcore Breach (Rank 20 toggle): no Gate Boons, one life, x1.5 Alloy.

rewards.first_clear: Endless Breach (upgrade doc 9.4, Commander Rank 12): pays Alloy per floor reached and Cores at floor milestones 10, 20 and 30 once per week; best floor shown on the main menu.
rewards.power: Floor power = 0.6 x the player's frontier zone Recommended Power x 1.06^(floor - 1), so floor 1 is a warm-up and floor ~10 matches the frontier.
rewards.between_floors: Gate Boon choice (one of three run-long upgrades: +10% fire rate, +1 dash charge, +15 max HP, card reroll, +20% power-up duration, ...) or full heal.
rewards.leaderboards: Best floor per hero, global and friends; a weekly seed ladder with the same layouts for everyone.
rewards.replay: The long-term build test: it mixes every mechanic, so it is where players prove a build and farm Alloy for gear levels.

stars.3: Reach floor 30 and beat the two-boss floor 25.
stars.bonus: Reach floor 15 (Daily Ops bonus: reach floor 10 with a hero you didn't use yesterday).

layout_notes.gate-a: Gate Antechamber. The gate ring in the middle (the portal is the main spawn), opening south; three uplink rings, two relays, crates as cover.
layout_notes.gate-arena: Gauntlet Arena. Open arena with four pits for shove kills, two vents, pillars, two med stations at the south; the boss enters from the north.
